name: Livingston County, MI
findings: Livingston County has 573 nonprofit organizations. 263 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 213 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Livingston County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 economic development organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Livingston County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 6 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 13 would.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 29 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
